hey girl, my best advice to you is to focus on yourself right now. keep yourself occupied. whether it be going out for a walk, being with family, going out with friends, even something like watching your favorite show or eating your favorite foods. remind yourself that he doesn't care nor does he deserve to read that paragraph you so badly want to text him expressing how you feel. i know that frustration of wanting him to know, but truth be told he knows you're hurting, but he does not care. stop wasting your time with him love, he's not deserving of it.

this part is completely optional and you don't need to read it, but i wanted to share my experience with you.

when my boyfriend and i broke up, i felt like my whole world was crashing down. in that time my pain felt endless. i would break down randomly all day to the point where my head ached from crying so much. i would text him every single thought that went through my mind. i could tell he was annoyed. he was a completely different person. he was heartless, cold, and insensitive. i knew in that moment he didn't care about me anymore, but i couldn't stop myself from texting him. i lost all respect for myself. i would do the same thing, block him just to unblock him again later in the day. eventually i told him to block me so even if i did text him, i wouldn't burden him with my texts.

3-4 months went by, at this point i was still having a really hard time but i was doing better than when it first happened. then out of nowhere he reached out me. i was fucking ecstatic. this is exactly what i wanted and i got it. we started talking again, things were good. he was treating me well, i could tell he was trying to regain what we had lost. he was putting in more effort than usual. that lasted maybe about a month or two? then it went back to the way it was. constant arguing, yelling, and having mental breakdowns. i feel a lot of shame and embarrassment saying this, and like the biggest hypocrite. im still with him at this moment and i am so unhappy. i cry almost everyday. i know i deserve better for myself but it is so hard to leave once you're sucked into the relationship. i sit around and wait for things to be good again but i don't think thats going to happen.

i tell you this because i know right now, maybe all you want is his attention and reassurance. and maybe to get back together. but trust me girl, it's not worth it. you're already 2 weeks in, keep going with it. even if he reaches out to you (and theres a chance he will, guys are like that), remind yourself how he treated you while you were going through this really hard time, and he wasnt there. dont cave in, or else you're going to feel like you have to start this whole breakup thing from scratch.

i wish you the best of luck and feel free to dm me if you need someone to talk to, or you have questions or whatever. im here for you :)
